sources.title: Huangpu River Cruise Shanghai Guide (2026): Scenic Views & Tips
sources.content:
The Huangpu River spans 114 kilometers through Shanghai, originating from Dianshan Lake and flowing into the Yangtze River. It's one of the earliest artificially dredged rivers.

Best Time: Evening and night cruises are optimal. Lights along the Bund illuminate from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, best experience starting after 7:00 PM.

Ferry Service (Budget): 2 RMB per trip, 10 minutes. Three routes: Dongjin Line, Dongfu Line, Taigong Line. Best viewed from second floor.

Shiliupu Wharf Cruise: 45 minutes. Off-season: 100-120 RMB (daytime), 120 RMB (night). Peak: 120-150 RMB. Passes major landmarks including Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower.

Jinling East Road Wharf: 50 minutes. 60-80 RMB (day), 80-100 RMB (night). Less crowded.

Dragon Boat: 105-120 minutes. 225-320 RMB with meals. Night cruises only.

Book through online platforms for discounts. On-site purchases available at Shiliupu or Jinling wharves.

Family-friendly with safety measures. Children under certain heights get discounts or free admission.

Transportation: Metro Lines 10/14 to Yu Garden Station or Lines 10/2 to Nanjing East Road Station.

sources.title: Shanghai Huangpu River Cruise: Route, Price, Tips
sources.content:
The Huangpu River is called the Mother River of Shanghai, stretching 113 kilometers with average width of 400 meters. It divides the city into Pudong (east) and Puxi (west).

Most popular cruise: 50-minute classic route from Shiliupu Wharf passing Shanghai Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center, Jinmao Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Yangpu Bridge before returning along the opposite riverbank.

Cost: Approximately 150 yuan for sightseeing only. Duration: About 50 minutes. Hours: 11am–9:30pm. Boats depart every 15–30 minutes.

Tickets available at Shiliupu Wharf ticket office (Wai Ma Lu 80), online, ticket agents, or hotel concierge.

Passengers observe distinctive contrasts between classical European colonial buildings and modern skyscrapers.

Best times: March–May and September–November for pleasant weather and clear visibility. Night cruises offer spectacular neon-lit views. Bring a coat for deck areas.

sources.title: Complete guide to Shanghai Huangpu River cruise routes and schedules
sources.content:
The Huangpu River cruise is a relaxing way to have a panoramic view of Shanghai with the west-meets-east feature. It is the best way to admire Shanghai's classic skyline views.

The most popular is the 50-minute classic cruise from Shiliupu Wharf. Route: Shiliupu Wharf - Binjiang Avenue - Shanghai Tower - Shanghai International Convention Center - Oriental Pearl Tower - Qinhuangdao Wharf (U-turn) - North Bund - Sinar Mas Plaza - Waibaidu Bridge - Bund International Architecture Exhibition - Shiliupu Wharf.

Pricing varies by season: Nov. 26~Feb. 25 off season day cruise ¥90, night ¥115; Feb. 26~Nov. 25 peak season day ¥115, night ¥135; holiday price day ¥135, night ¥135.

Arrive at wharf at least 30 minutes in advance. Children under 1.3 meters are free but need a free child ticket at the ticket office. Free Chinese and English explanation provided onboard.

sources.title: Huangpu River Cruise: Map, What to See & Travel Tips
sources.content:
The Huangpu River cruise offers views of colonial architecture on the west bank and modern skyscrapers on the east. Multiple departure points and cruise durations available.

Night cruises are the most popular, offering views of illuminated buildings on both sides of the river. Bring warm clothing for deck viewing.

sources.title: 上海黄浦江游览_百度百科
sources.content:
上海黄浦江游览是上海的经典水上旅游项目。游客可乘游船观赏浦江两岸风光，领略外滩万国建筑博览群与陆家嘴现代天际线。项目包含日游、夜游及多条专题航线，提供餐饮、演艺、婚庆等衍生服务。

主要码头：十六铺旅游码头（核心码头，含1、2、3号码头）、金陵东路码头、东方明珠游船码头、国际客运中心码头、秦皇岛路游船码头、龙华码头。

经典航线：精华游（约45分钟，南浦大桥至杨浦大桥间）、快线游（60分钟）。特色航线：红色文化游、徐汇滨江航线、主题演艺航班。

运营企业：上海浦江游览集团有限公司（成立于1982年）。

2024年接待游客413.4万人次；2019年突破500万人次历史高峰。2025年投入首艘纯电池游览船上海久事号。

黄浦江上有23艘游船投入营运。水晶公主号是黄浦江上唯一五星级游船，总长59.98米，载客量380人。基础游览票价120元/位。

sources.title: Shanghai Huangpu River Cruise: Tickets, Routes and Travel Tips
sources.content:
The Huangpu River cruise is one of Shanghai's most popular tourist activities. Various cruise options are available from different wharves with durations ranging from 30 minutes to 2+ hours.

Most cruises depart from Shiliupu Wharf near the Bund. Night cruises are most popular for the illuminated skyline views. Book online for discounted prices.

Tips: Dress warmly for deck viewing, especially in winter. Night cruises offer the best visual experience. Arrive early to get a good seat.

sources.title: Huangpu River Cruise - Travel China Guide
sources.content:
The Huangpu River flows through the heart of Shanghai, separating Pudong from Puxi. A cruise on the river offers panoramic views of both the historic Bund architecture and the modern Pudong skyline.

Multiple cruise options are available from various wharves. The most popular is the classic 50-minute route from Shiliupu Wharf. Night cruises are highly recommended for the best visual experience when both banks are illuminated.

Tickets can be purchased at wharf ticket offices or through online platforms. Pricing varies by season, with peak season rates higher than off-season. Children under 1.3 meters ride free.

Free Chinese and English commentary is provided onboard. The cruise passes landmarks including the Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the historic Bund buildings.
